title: Witches Unite: How Israel and the US Empire Tried (and Failed) to Crush Francesca Albanese
author: Michael Leonardi
content:
[![](https://www.counterpunch.org/wp-
content/uploads/2026/05/0-2-680x453.jpeg)](https://www.counterpunch.org/2026/05/15/witches-
unite-how-israel-and-the-us-empire-tried-and-failed-to-crush-francesca-
albanese/)

![](https://www.counterpunch.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/0-2-680x453.jpeg)

Photograph Source: Matteo Nardone

The United States government, under first Biden and now Trump, has launched a
full-scale assault on one of the most courageous and honest voices at the
United Nations: Francesca Albanese, the UN Special Rapporteur on the Occupied
Palestinian Territories. In July 2025, Secretary of State Marco Rubio
announced sanctions against her — freezing assets, banning travel to the
United States, and attempting to financially strangle her and her family — all
for the crime of doing her job with integrity: rigorously documenting Israel’s
genocide in Gaza and demanding accountability under international law.

In an unprecedented move, this appears to be the first time any country has
ever sanctioned a sitting UN Special Rapporteur. The Trump administration’s
attack has been particularly vicious. Israeli officials, led by UN envoy Danny
Danon, had already resorted to medieval slander, publicly calling Albanese a
“witch” with a “spell book” for daring to produce factual reports on Israeli
crimes. The sanctions were designed to turn her into a global financial
outcast: she has been blocked from accessing bank accounts, using credit
cards, or managing any financial resources in both the US and Europe. Even
banks in Italy and across the EU refused to open or allow access to her
accounts out of fear of secondary US sanctions. Shockingly, neither the
Italian government nor the broader European Union offered any meaningful
defense of their own citizen and internationally mandated expert.

Thankfully, on May 13, 2026, a federal judge issued a temporary reprieve,
suspending the sanctions and delivering a sharp rebuke to the Trump
administration’s blatant attempt to punish protected speech and intimidate a
UN mandate-holder. The ruling provides critical breathing room for Albanese
and her family, though the broader threat remains.

Francesca Albanese has become one of the most authoritative and courageous
international voices on Palestine. Since her appointment in 2022, she has
methodically dismantled the lies shielding Israel’s colonial project. Her
reports, grounded rigorously in international humanitarian and human rights
law, have laid bare the reality: Israel is committing genocide, maintaining an
apartheid regime, and pursuing the ethnic cleansing of the Palestinian people.
Her landmark 2024 report “Anatomy of a Genocide” and subsequent work have
become essential reading.

Her powerful book, When the World Sleeps: Stories, Words, and Wounds of
Palestine (released in English in April 2026), has already become a
![](https://www.counterpunch.org/wp-
content/uploads/2026/05/unnamed-1.jpg)bestseller. The documentary DisUnited
Nations further amplifies her courageous navigation of institutional cowardice
at the UN while exposing the complicity of powerful member states.

Italy and Europe stand exposed in their moral bankruptcy. Despite Albanese
being an Italian national, the Meloni government — ever eager to prove its
loyalty to Washington and Tel Aviv — offered her no support, while continuing
military and economic cooperation with the genocidal regime. The broader
European Union has chosen complicity over conscience.

Meanwhile, Israel and its AIPAC-driven allies in the United States have spent
hundreds of millions on hasbara — a sophisticated propaganda machine designed
to whitewash the sadistic face of Zionism. But the mask has slipped. The
colonial, settler project stands exposed: a European transplant in the Middle
East, an ethno-supremacist state built on the erasure of the indigenous
Palestinian people who are the actual Semitic inhabitants of the land. The
European colonizers, who founded “Israel” with their decimation of over 500
Palestinian villages and forced expulsion of millions of Palestinians
beginning with the Nakba in 1948, are not.

Despite the massive propaganda blitz by Zionist forces, a global awakening is
underway. Millions now see Zionism for what it is: a racist, supremacist
ideology rooted in colonial conquest and maintained through relentless
violence and apartheid. The live-streamed genocide since October 2023 has torn
away the final illusions.

The sanctions against Albanese were never only about her. They were about
sending a message: speak truth to Israeli power and the empire will come for
you. The temporary court victory is welcome, but the deeper fight continues.

Francesca Albanese remains undeterred. Her courage, intellectual rigor, and
moral clarity continue to inspire millions. She is doing what the United
Nations was supposed to do — but rarely does: speak truth to power and defend
the oppressed.

The empire is striking back because it is losing the battle for legitimacy.
The more frantically it attacks voices like Albanese’s, the clearer it becomes
that the Zionist project and its imperial backers are on the wrong side of
history.

**Defend Francesca Albanese.** **End the sanctions on truth-tellers.** **End
the genocide in Gaza.** **End the occupation.** **Free Palestine.**
